narrator_intro.speaker: Narrator
narrator_intro.text: The fog parts around a crooked stone lantern. Someone is waiting beneath it.

mira_greeting.speaker: Mira
mira_greeting.text: You made it through the fog. Most travelers turn back before the lantern comes into view.

mira_offer.speaker: Mira
mira_offer.text: The old signal lantern has gone dark. If you relight it, the path ahead will open. Will you help?

choices.text: What is in it for me?

mira_accept.speaker: Mira
mira_accept.text: Then take this spark. The lantern is north of here, past the broken bridge.

mira_bargain.speaker: Mira
mira_bargain.text: A warm meal, a dry bed, and first pick from the supply chest. Fair enough?

mira_decline.speaker: Mira
mira_decline.text: I understand. The fog is patient. I will be here if you change your mind.

mira_farewell.speaker: Mira
mira_farewell.text: Keep the spark close. The dark does not like being interrupted.
